dct_description_sm: Water quality data are collecting using tools in the Water Rangers Freshwater Explorer testkit, including portable probes and test strips, conductivity meter, secchi disc, and dissolved oxygen tests.  Long term trends are tracked and logged on the Water Rangers data platform.  Additional microbiological and chemical analysis samples are collected and tested at an external laboratory and data sets are managed internally and published on Skootamatta District Ratepayers Association website.
